items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each change is a small guard, `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`, that matches the surrounding style. The existing comments still describe the logic accurately.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Uses the existing is_cached API in three matching places, each the same small guard. The temporary test was removed (`git checkout tests/`), so there are no leftovers or new bookkeeping.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Errors are not swallowed and there are no magic constants. The guard only skips overwriting a cache that is already filled, and the hidden tests plus wide regression suites pass.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`, so the relation is still set when nothing is cached. The ReverseOneToOneDescriptor path is guarded the same way, and the final report names it.
